note: The ring's near edge (2026-09-28, the user: build the ring from the approved top wall as the reference): the bottom section at 640x360, the wall seen from its top with the gate's opening, to be joined to the top wall through the sand. Two seeds.

body.description: the near edge of the same Roman colosseum arena, seen from high above at the same scale and angle as the reference: packed ochre sand with a few scuffed patches and small rocks fills the upper two thirds; along the bottom the top of the curved stone arena wall seen from above, its cut-block coping running from the left edge to the right edge, curving up at both sides; in the middle of the wall a gate opening seen from above; below the wall the first rows of stone stands; the same style, colours, and scale as the reference; no people, no lettering

reference_images.usage: the same arena: match its wall, sand, stands, scale, and colours; this image is its far edge, draw the near edge
